newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: SKODA COMPLETES HALF MILLION FELICIA CARS.
newsitem.headline: SKODA COMPLETES HALF MILLION FELICIA CARS.

text.p: The Czech car making unit of Volkswagen AG, Skoda Automobilova a.s., said on Thursday that it had completed 500,000 of its flagship Felicia compacts since production on the VW-upgraded car began in October 1994.

The company, in Mlada Boleslav north of Prague, said in a statement it planned a 10 percent increase in production to 262,000 of the Felicia line which is a plusher version of Skoda's more boxy communist era hatchback, the Favorit.
Skoda launched its first mid-sized Octavia line last autumn.
Earlier this month, Skoda reported overall unit sales for the first two months of this year were up 10.5 percent, year-on-year, with sales growth of more than 30 percent reported in western Europe.
Volkswagen took control of Skoda, building up a 70 percent stake in the company by 1995, after participating in the company's post-Communist privatisation earlier in the decade.
